title: Hourly Graphika Auto-Dig: public offices and current-news scan
summary: Dataset-first hourly pass selected Graphika; added two first-party office locations without promoting either to headquarters and found no post-July-31 material Graphika news item on the reviewed first-party report/insight surfaces.

data.research_question: What defensible public organizational locations can be added for Graphika, and has Graphika published or been covered in materially new current news since the prior July 31 Graphika pass?
data.method: Refreshed current main at dc5d57abb276dd2459a8e72fa8da6020fb108d31. Enumerated 27 physical dig roots from the current corpus. Excluded free-range as a meta-root and excluded fed, dnc, and wef-columbus under the last-three successful-hourly anti-repeat rules, leaving 23 eligible dataset/topic roots. Reproducible dataset seed 3225186989625628953 selected graphika uniformly at dataset stage. The Graphika manifest contains 28 canonical records, including three organization records. HQ-target eligibility excluded the U.S. Department of Defense because Washington, D.C. repeated the dominant geography of two recent hourly passes; among the remaining organization candidates, Meta already has a mature corporate-location surface while Graphika's canonical org record had no location_ids or headquarters value. Reproducible target seed 10630753916786041709 selected starintel:org:graphika-technologies. The first-party Graphika contact page lists New York and Washington, D.C. office addresses but does not label either headquarters, so both were modeled only as public organizational offices and no coordinates were inferred. Current-news search reviewed Graphika reports, insights, in-the-media pages, and external web/news results for August 2026; no materially new post-July-31 item was found, so no filler news event was created.
classification_rules: exclude last three successful hourly roots when alternatives exist
avoid repeated dominant geography when alternatives exist
office address is not headquarters without explicit designation
no news filler when no material post-cutoff development is found

findings.finding: Graphika publishes 1230 Avenue of the Americas Studio, 16th Floor, New York, NY 10020 as its New York office.
Graphika publishes 900 19th St NW Studio, 6th Floor, Washington, DC 20006 as its Washington, D.C. office.
The reviewed first-party contact page does not identify either office as headquarters.
No materially new post-July-31 Graphika news item was found on the reviewed report, insight, media, and external news surfaces.
